# Mod API: Session

`$.session` lets a mod read the running session as plain data, compact it, and send messages to other agents or sessions.
Its events tell a mod when a session starts, ends, compacts, or gets a message.
This hook shows a toast when a session starts:

```javascript
on('session.start', async ($, e, next) => {
  $.ui.toast('Session started')
  return next(e)
})
```

In the "Where" column, **Run time** means in a hook, in a closure that a hook drew, or in a timer callback.
It does not mean inside `register`.

## Engine Events

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `session.start` | Fires once per process for each loaded plugin, before the first prompt, then once per fresh load of one (never `/clear`), `next(e)` is `{ cwd }`. | Input `SessionStartInput`. Result `SessionStartResult`. Hook result: `{ cwd }`. The first run is awaited, so a `$.tool.register` in it is listed by turn one. | Hook via `on('session.start', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.start(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4445, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.receive` | Fires when a delivery reaches the session, before it is queued: a relay's event, a peer's message, a Remote Control prompt, room events, `{ text }`. | Input `SessionReceiveInput`. Result `SessionReceiveResult`. Hook result: `{ text }` or `{ consumed }`. Return `{ consumed: reason }` to stop the message from reaching the model. | Hook via `on('session.receive', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.receive(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4457, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.append` | Fires once per row a conversation of this session keeps (a prompt, a response block, a tool result, a notice), before it is stored. | Input `SessionAppendInput`. Result `SessionAppendResult`. Hook result: `{ message, uuid }`. `next({ ...e, message })` rewrites `content` before it is stored. | Hook via `on('session.append', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.append(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4469, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.send` | Fires when a plain-text message is about to leave this conversation for another agent or session (the SendMessage tool, or `$.session.send`). | Input `SessionSendInput`. Result `SessionSendResult`. Hook result: `{ isDelivered }`. Rewrite `text` or `to` with `next`. Return `{ isDelivered: false, reason }` to refuse. | Hook via `on('session.send', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.send(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4481, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.compact` | Fires when the conversation is about to be compacted (`/compact`, the threshold, a plugin, or ahead of time), `next(e)` resolves `{ messages }`. | Input `SessionCompactInput`. Result `SessionCompactResult`. Hook result: `{ messages }` or `{ skip }`. `{ skip: reason }` leaves the conversation as it is. | Hook via `on('session.compact', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.compact(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4493, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.attach` | Fires when a remote client joins the session's roster of attached surfaces: it said so (ui_attach), or it first asked to draw. | Input `SessionAttachInput`. Result `SessionAttachResult`. Hook result: `{ clientId }`. A hook observes a client that joins. `$.session.surfaces()` reads the roster. | Hook via `on('session.attach', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.attach(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4505, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.detach` | Fires when a client leaves the roster: it detached, or the session ended with it attached (`e.reason`). Observe, `next(e)` echoes `{ clientId }`. | Input `SessionDetachInput`. Result `SessionDetachResult`. Hook result: `{ clientId }`. With reason `end` it runs inside the short bound of `session.end`. | Hook via `on('session.detach', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.detach(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4513, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.measure` | Fires when the engine measures the session and a unit moved: after each main-thread turn, and when a rate-limit window moves a whole point. | Input `SessionMeasureInput`. Result `SessionMeasureResult`. Hook result: `{ changed }`. It pushes the figures of `$.session.usage()`. Calls arrive one at a time. | Hook via `on('session.measure', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.measure(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4525, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `session.end` | Fires once when the session ends (exit, /clear, resume, logout, signal, a `-p` run done), after its SessionEnd settings hooks, `e.reason` says which. | Input `SessionEndInput`. Result `SessionEndResult`. Hook result: `{ sessionId }`. The whole chain shares one short time bound that `next.budget` reads. | Hook via `on('session.end', ...)`. Also callable as `$.session.end(...)`. | `EngineEventOf` line 4537, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
